headingHtml: Rp 6 million sends one child to school for a whole year.

benefits.title: School fees
benefits.text: A full year of tuition, from middle school to university.

benefits.title: Uniform & supplies
benefits.text: Books, uniform and the essentials to show up ready.

benefits.title: English classes
benefits.text: Small groups, every week, around school hours.

benefits.title: A dedicated mentor
benefits.text: A community manager guiding each child's progress.

benefits.title: Trips & workshops
benefits.text: Hands-on learning at farms, makers and sustainability projects.

benefits.title: Family support
benefits.text: Help for families when everyday needs get in the way of school.

donut.ariaLabel: Scholarship goal for 2026/27: 15 high-school, 14 middle-school, 12 vocational high-school, 7 junior high and 2 university students
